description.value: The Vic Downtown is a specialty cafe in the heart of Kamloops that roasts its own coffee beans in small batches on-site and stocks over 65 varieties of loose-leaf tea. Situated on the corner of 4th and Victoria, the shop draws a loyal downtown crowd to its sunny patio and comfortable interior. Touring cyclists will find a broad food menu spanning breakfast sandwiches, wraps, pastries, and savoury baked goods alongside quality locally-roasted coffee.

The front page explicitly states 'free wifi and plenty of outlets,' confirming Wi-Fi and device charging. The menu page lists GF, dairy-free, and vegetarian items by name, confirming that amenity. No bike rack, washroom, or water refill language appears anywhere on the site.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established downtown Kamloops cafe with confirmed free Wi-Fi, charging outlets, GF/vegetarian food options, and a full food menu — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.
